headline: Taiwan Mobile's Tender Offer for Jingcheng Information Kicks Off, Already Secures Over 14% in Sell Commitments | Securities
summary: Taiwan Mobile's wholly owned subsidiary Taixin Telecom launched a tender offer for Jingcheng Information, with acceptance running to 3:30 p.m. on 6 October. Commitments covering about 14.13% of shares have been obtained.
why: Taiwan Mobile is a major Taiwanese telecom operator, and tender offers are a common route for a buyer to gain control of a listed company.
